metadata.description: Single-model internal safety metrics (activation geometry, weight spectral, attention, logit-only, supervised probe) computed across a 10-model panel spanning three Qwen lineages, evaluated for safe-vs-abliterated separability with bootstrap CIs, benchmark-anchored rank correlation, zero-shot cross-lineage probe transfer, and pre-registered held-out confirmation

Qwen3-4B-abliterated.substitution: huihui-ai/Qwen3-4B-abliterated had no cached weights; mlabonne/Qwen3-4B-abliterated (FailSpy orthogonalization recipe on the same Qwen3-4B) is fully cached and is the same role

contrasts.c1_safe_vs_abliterated: safety-tuned (instruct/saferl) vs abliterated, pooled across lineages
contrasts.c2_tuned_vs_base: chat-tuned vs base (template effects excluded: base uses raw format)
contrasts.c4_saferl_vs_instruct_qwen3-4b: official safety-RL tune vs plain instruct, same lineage
contrasts.c6_within_qwen2.5-3b: held-out lineage: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct vs its abliterated SFT
contrasts.c7_within_qwen3-4b-2507: second 4B line: Instruct-2507 vs its abliterated twin

Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.refusal_src: Qwen2.5 technical report safety-eval refusal table, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct

Qwen2.5-3B-abliterated.refusal_src: huihui-ai model card: abliterated SFT variant, targets near-zero refusal (no official number)

Qwen3-1.7B.cap_src: Qwen3 technical report MMLU-Redux 5-shot, Qwen3-1.7B non-thinking

Qwen3-1.7B-Base.refusal_src: Qwen3 technical report refusal table (base completion model)

Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507.refusal_src: Qwen3-2507 technical report refusal table, Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507
